name: Icon
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Icon. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Icon mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for icon mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Text icon
settings.info: Use a symbol, emoji, short icon label, or icon font character.
settings.how: Enter the text icon. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: SVG code
settings.info: Paste inline SVG markup. Use trusted SVG only.
settings.how: Write the svg code. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Icon image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust icon size. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Icon color
settings.how: Choose a color for icon color. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Show background
settings.how: Turn on “Show background” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
